name: Pro Planet P5
summary: The A. O. Smith ProPlanet P5 RO Water Purifier features an advanced 8-stage RO purification system with SCMT and MIN-TECH to deliver 100% RO purified, mineral-rich drinking water .
intro: The A. O. Smith ProPlanet P5 RO Water Purifier features an advanced 8-stage RO purification system with Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) and MIN-TECH to deliver 100% RO purified, mineral-rich, baby-safe drinking water. Its Advanced Recovery Technology (ART™ MAX) saves up to 2X more water than conventional RO purifiers, making it India's 5-Star Rated 100% RO Water Purifier. With a 9-litre storage tank, digital display, and wall-mount/table-top installation, it is ideal for homes using borewell, tanker, or mixed water sources.
